climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

land: Faces the morning sun. Early light dries the dew, which cuts disease, and the grapes are spared the hottest afternoon sun.

blurb.text: An Alsace Grand Cru vineyard in Wintzenheim. Its wines can be made from seven grapes: Riesling, Gewürztraminer, Pinot Gris and three Muscats (Muscat Blanc à Petits Grains, Muscat Rose à Petits Grains and Muscat Ottonel) and Pinot Noir for red.
